morgabriel.name: Mor Gabriel Monastery
morgabriel.slogan: Prayer has not stopped on this hill since the 4th century.
morgabriel.line: Founded in 397 AD, it is among the oldest continuously active Christian monasteries in the world.

deyrulzafaran.name: Deyrulzafaran Monastery
deyrulzafaran.slogan: Honey-coloured walls where Syriac patriarchs once held court.
deyrulzafaran.line: Founded in 493 AD, it was the seat of the Syriac Orthodox Patriarchs from about 1160 until the 20th century.

zinciriye.name: Zinciriye Medrese
zinciriye.slogan: Carved portal below, the whole Mesopotamian plain beyond.
zinciriye.line: Its inscription dates completion to 3 February 1385, under the Artuqid ruler Sultan Isa.

daraancientcity.name: Dara Ancient City
daraancientcity.slogan: A Roman border fortress with a city of rock tombs at its feet.
daraancientcity.line: Ordered by Emperor Anastasius around 505, Dara saw Belisarius beat the Persians in 530.

midyatkonukevi.name: Midyat Old Town
midyatkonukevi.slogan: Carved limestone mansions and church towers glowing like honey.
midyatkonukevi.line: Midyat is the main town of Tur Abdin, the 'mountain of the servants of God', heartland of the Syriac Christians.
